content.text: {"title":"Happy Fall Basswood Sign","product":"sign","mode":"cut","widthIn":12,"heightIn":12,"layers":[{"id":"wood","name":"Basswood sheet 1/16 in — natural","supplyId":"sup-24","color":"#d9b48f","operation":"cut"},{"id":"vinyl","name":"Glossy permanent vinyl — black","supplyId":"sup-01","color":"#1a1a1a","operation":"cut"}],"elements":[{"kind":"text","layer":"vinyl","text":"HAPPY","font":"Alfa Slab One","capHeightIn":1.2,"x":6,"y":3.6,"rotationDeg":0,"letterSpacing":0.08},{"kind":"text","layer":"vinyl","text":"FALL","font":"Alfa Slab One","capHeightIn":2.6,"x":6,"y":6.9,"rotationDeg":0,"letterSpacing":0.04},{"kind":"branch","stemLayer":"vinyl","leafLayers":["vinyl"],"veinLayer":"","x":2.6,"y":11.6,"heightIn":1.8,"rotationDeg":-25,"leafShape":"leaf-pointed","leafCount":3,"leafLengthIn":0.6,"curve":"gentle"},{"kind":"branch","stemLayer":"vinyl","leafLayers":["vinyl"],"veinLayer":"","x":9.4,"y":11.6,"heightIn":1.8,"rotationDeg":25,"leafShape":"leaf-pointed","leafCount":3,"leafLengthIn":0.6,"curve":"gentle"}],"assembly":["Design the 'HAPPY FALL' word art with the two small leaf sprigs, sized to fit the 12x12 in basswood sheet.","Load black vinyl on the standard grip mat and cut the design with the fine-point tool.","Weed away the extra vinyl, keeping only the letters and leaf sprigs, which are welded so each word and sprig lifts as one clean piece.","Lay transfer tape over the weeded design, burnish well, then peel off the paper backing and lift the design.","Center the design on the 12x12 in basswood sheet and press down firmly, working from the center outward, then peel away the transfer tape.","Lean the finished sign on a shelf or prop it against the backsplash."]}
